quarterly_data.signal: On August 13, 2026 Core Scientific completed its acquisition of Polaris DS LLC, securing the approximately 440 MW of in-service gross, grid-connected power capacity used by Polaris under existing electric service agreements with Oklahoma Gas & Electric. The company said site acquisitions this year have added more than 600 MW of leasable power to its portfolio.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 600 MW of leasable power added through site acquisitions this year; Polaris acquisition completed August 13, 2026
